id.name: Grid.scale_succ
id.content:
lemma scale_succ (h : ¬IsMax i) : s i.succ = s i + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := succ_spec h
  rw [lt_def] at h₁; apply le_antisymm _ (by omega)
  by_contra! h₀
  obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂, hz₃⟩ :=
    exists_sandwiched (le_succ (i := i)) (s i + 1) (by rw [mem_Icc]; omega)
  have l := (lt_def.mpr ⟨hz₃.1, hz₁.symm ▸ h₀⟩).trans_le (h₂ z (lt_def.mpr ⟨hz₂.1, by omega⟩))
  rwa [lt_self_iff_false] at l

theorem lt_self_iff_false (x : α) : x < x ↔ False :=

C1_dependencies.name: IsMax
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- `a` is a maximal element of `α` if no element is strictly greater than it. We spell it without
`<` to avoid having to convert between `≤` and `<`. Instead, `isMax_iff_forall_not_lt` does the
conversion. -/
def IsMax (a : α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃b⦄, a ≤ b → b ≤ a
